tasks.label: drunc-ui: dbt development server
tasks.command: bash -c 'cd "${workspaceFolder}/../.." && source ./env.sh && cd "${workspaceFolder}" && export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=drunc_ui.settings.settings DB_ENGINE=django.db.backends.sqlite3 DB_NAME="$PWD/db.sqlite3" DJANGO_STATICFILES_STORAGE=django.contrib.staticfiles.storage.StaticFilesStorage && drunc-ui-manage migrate && drunc-ui-manage shell -c "from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model; from django.core.management import call_command; call_command(\"createsuperuser\") if not get_user_model().objects.filter(is_superuser=True).exists() else print(\"Superuser already exists; skipping creation.\")" && exec drunc-ui-manage runserver 127.0.0.1:8000'
